content: Mbole ya agho, nikiyihwa lilobhe handa lya lumati lukulu lwa bhandu kunani kwa Chapanga, palilongela, “Katikilwe Bambo Chapanga. Ulopohi na ukulu na likalama ndo hyake Chapanga ghwetu.
Mana toso yake ndo ya hoto na ndo muyinoghwa. Kantosa yula nngongola nkulu ywakaapotohite bhandu bha nnima kwa utyahe ghwake, Chapanga kanhyatula kubhukana na kuakoma andumitumi bhake.”
Bhakikweha kangi kwa lilobhe likulu, “Katikilwe Bambo Chapanga. Lyohi lya mwoto ghuuyocha kitami kila ghungututuma kughenda kunani manjubha ghoha kyanga uhiko.”
Bhala aghohi ishilini na ncheche, na bhala hibhumbe ncheche hinaubhumi, bhakiliponeha makukama, bhakintundamila Chapanga ywakatamite mukiteho kya ghubhutwa, palongela, “Mwika, Chapanga katikilwe.”
Mulyo ghwa chekwa ya kutolela kwa Mwanamene

Mbole, likiyihwanika lilobhe kuhuma mukiteho kila kya ghubhutwa, palilongela, “Muntike Chapanga ghwetu, mwenga andumitumi bhake bhoha, mabhoha munakuhokamila, bhandu ahwadali na bhanga kubhegha ahwadali.”

Nikiyihwa kangi lilobhe handa lya lumati lukulu munu lwa bhandu na lupwato lukulu lwa ngumbwa ya machi na handa lulundumo lukulu lwa njahe, palilongela. “Muntike Chapanga. Kiyaha Bambo Chapanga, yunamakakala, katabhala.
Tuyelelwe, tulumbalile na kumpegha ukulu, kiyaha linjubha lya chekwa ya kutolela kwa Mwanamene lihika kala, na nndala yunakutolelwa kalibhika kala.
Chapanga kampegha lipinda lihuhu lya mbuletee ili kahwale, linakung'anyima na nyanyi.” Habhu lipinda alyo lya nyanyi, ndo mandendelo gha maha gha bhandu bha Chapanga.

Mbole, nndumitumi ghwa kunani kwa Chapanga kaking'ombela, “Ghutyeke agha, Bhanonelwa bhala bhoha bhaalalikitwe kuyingila muchekwa ya mulyo ghwa kutolela ya Mwanamene.” Kangi, ndumitumi aywo kakighendelela kung'ombela, “Agha ndo malagho gha hoto gha Chapanga.”

Basi, nenga nikighwegha makukama muulongolo ghwa maghulu ghake, nikipala kuntundamila, peni ywombe kaking'ombela, “Ghukotoke kutenda naha! Twenga twabhoha tungunnandamiha Yesu. Kila kaakilongela mambuye ghanguhuma kwa Yesu. Ghuntundamile Chapanga.” Kiyaha ubhoneho ghwa Yesu ndo uyimiho ghwa nhuki ghwa mambuye bha Chapanga.
Mutwa nkulu unani mwa fwalasi nhuhu
Mbole, nikibhona kunani kwa Chapanga kuhughuka, na akwo kakibhegha fwalasi yumu nhuhu mbuletee na yula ywakanhubhukite kakikemwa nhyubhaliko na hoto, ywombe kangutosa muyinoghwa na kututana ngondo.

Meho ghake ndo handa mibhale ya mwoto na unani mwa mutwe ghwake kubhegha na hilemba hitangalo. Kakibhegha na lihina liityekitwe unani mwake lyene kahone mundu ywohele ywakalimanyite maha nga ywombe ghweka chake.
Kakibhegha kahwala lijoho liijabikitwe mumwahi na lihina lyake ndo “Lilagho lya Chapanga.”
Machonda bha kunani kwa Chapa bhakintughila, bhakikwela fwalasi ahuhu pabhabhele bhahwala mapinda gha mahuhu mbulete na nyanyi muno.

Mu ngulo yake ghubwitukagha lukechelo lunautemo lwene kwa alwo lukechelo katabhahotola bhandu bha milima yoha. Katabhatabhala kwa ughololeho na kuyikama difwai mukyombo kya kukamila sabibu ya kiyaghabhu kikulu kya Chapanga yuna makakala.
Mu lijoho lyake na lupanja lwake patyekwa lihina. “Mutwa ghwa abhatwa na Bambo ghwa mabambo.”

Mbole, nikimmona nndumitumi yumu ywa kunani kwa Chapanga, kayima pa luchubha. Kakikweha lilobhe na kubhakema hiyuni bhoha bhanakughuluka kunani kubhwelo, “Nhike na nkwemukane papamu kwa kya mulyo ghwa Chekwa ngulu ya Chapanga.

Nhike nlyeghe nyama ya mibhili ya abhatwa, na ya machonda hilongohi, na ya bhandu bhanamakakala, na nyama ya fwalasi na akwela fwalasi bhabhe, nhike mukalyeghe mibhili ya bhandu bhoha, bhaabheghite abhandwa na bhanga kubhegha abhandwa, bhandu ahwadali na bhanga kubhegha ahwadali.”

Mbole nikibhona yula likokolo likalipa papamu na mutwa ghwa nnima na machonda bhabhe, bhakwemukana papamu kwa nningo ghwa bhatutane na yula ywakatamite unani mwa fwalasi nhuhu papamu na machonda bhake.

Yula likokolo likalipa likipukilwa kinduteni, papamu na mbuye ghwa uhwangi ywakabheghite kangutenda mihabho muulongolo ghwake. Kwa mihabho ayo, kakibhegha kangubhapotoha bhala bhaabheghite na himatiko hya likokolo alyo, na bhaalitundamilite ling'mo ng'omo lyake. Abha abhili bhakitaghwa kunu bhakibhegha na ubhumi nkati ya lihibha linakuyaka mwoto ghwa kibiliti.
Machonda bhabhe bhakikomwa kwa lukechelo luubhwitukite munnomo ghwa yula ywakanhubhukite fwalasi nhuhu. Hiyuni bhoha bhakilyegha na kuyukuta nyama ya abho amyanja bhabhe.
